meta.description: Asset index for Phaser. All paths are relative to basePath (this file's folder).
notes: Load spritesheets with this.load.spritesheet(key, basePath+path, { frameWidth, frameHeight }).
Every spritesheet has a pathWithShadow alternative (same frame size) baked with a drop shadow.
Animation frameRate values are suggested defaults, not from the source files.
Directions: 'left'/'right' are side views, 'front' faces the camera.
Flora atlases (flora_*): wildflowers, bushes, stumps, logs and stones. Frame names are unique across all flora sheets.

tilesets.notes: Tile index = row*8 + col. Top rows are grass-topped dirt; bottom rows are dark soil and blue stone brick.

atlases.notes: Irregular layout. Load as an image, then register frames with texture.add(name, 0, x, y, w, h).
Flora sheet: 5x3 grid of 32x32 cells. Frames are the cells trimmed to their opaque pixels, so a frame's bottom edge is where the plant meets the ground. Source and license not recorded yet.
